final: WITH m AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS ap, AVG(CASE WHEN Bytes IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(Bytes AS REAL)/Milliseconds END) AS br FROM Track GROUP BY MediaTypeId), g AS (SELECT AVG(br) AS gavg FROM m WHERE br IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(m.ap) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(m.br) AS avg_byte_rate, AVG(m.br - g.gavg) AS avg_excess FROM m, g WHERE m.br > g.gavg
